observed_product_order: SubagentTombstoneStore.begin_call writes durable inflight marker before write_file/edit_file/run_shell.
On normalized ok=true, server_subagent_runtime immediately calls tombstone_store.resolve_call and removes the durable marker.
Only after execute_tool returns does DelegatedToolLoopSession append function_call_output to its process-local _history.
NotionDelegationAdapter creates that child session in memory before leasing and exposes no durable child-history/result store.
crash_boundary: hard process crash after resolve_call successfully removed the durable marker but before the process-local child tool result/final completion is durably published anywhere
risk: After restart the same logical child task is no longer tombstoned, its local history is gone, and replay from the objective may execute the already-confirmed mutation a second time.
why_existing_tests_do_not_close_it: test_server_subagent_durable_tool_guard_v2 explicitly expects confirmed success to clear the marker immediately.
test_server_subagent_tombstone_restart covers restart only while an inflight marker still exists.
No current test crashes after confirmed tool success and marker removal but before durable child completion/history publication.
required_contract: A confirmed mutating tool result must not erase the last durable no-replay evidence before an equally durable child-progress/final-result publication exists.
Use a durable per-task state transition such as inflight -> completed_uncommitted (or a durable child history journal) instead of inflight -> absent immediately on ok=true.
After restart, completed_uncommitted must fail closed or reconstruct exact child progress; it must never relaunch the objective and mutate again automatically.
Clear the task-level no-replay state only in the same proven ordering as durable child completion/history publication.
This should be integrated with Notion Core durable replay/intent work rather than adding an unrelated second recovery protocol.
limits: No hosted CI, provider/Notion/Codex traffic, Windows, production, user data or secrets used.
Linux/offline regression does not prove native Windows durability semantics.
